title: Placenta specific gene manipulation by transducing zona-free blastocyst using lentiviral vector
protocol: Contact the animal facility at your institute to perform proper animal experimentation.
Inject 5 units of PMSG intraperitoneally around noon on Day 1.
Inject 5 units of HCG intraperitoneally after a 48-hour interval on Day 3.
Mate superovulated females with stud males (one female per male) the day after HCG injection.
Check for vaginal plugs in the morning on Day 5.
Collect embryos at either the 2-4 cell stage or blastocyst stage depending on protocol A or B.
Prepare a flushing needle filled with FHM.
Remove oviducts from mated females and keep them covered with mineral oil.
Place each oviduct in a 20 micro-L drop of FHM covered with mineral oil.
Insert the flushing needle into the infundibulum to harvest embryos with FHM.
Collect embryos using an embryo-handling pipette.
Wash embryos three times by transferring them serially through kSOM drops covered with mineral oil.
Incubate embryos at 37°C and 5% CO₂ for 2 more days.
Collect blastocysts in the morning.
Remove uterus from mated females and keep it covered with mineral oil.
Cut off both ends of the uterus and flush out the uterus with 100 μL of FHM using a P200 pipette into 60 mm dishes.
Collect embryos with an embryo-handling pipette.
Wash embryos three times by serially transferring them in 50 μL kSOM drops covered with mineral oil.
Incubate embryos at 37°C and 5% CO₂ until use.
Prepare 20 μL drops of acidic Tyrode’s solution on 60 mm dishes.
Prepare FHM washing drops on the same dish.
Cover all drops with mineral oil.
Pipette blastocysts up and down three to four times in a drop of acidic Tyrode’s solution for a few seconds.
Transfer zona-free blastocysts into another drop once the zona dissolves, approximately after 30 seconds.
Wash zona-free blastocysts three times in FHM drops.
Wash zona-free blastocysts three times in kSOM droplets.
Incubate zona-free blastocysts at 37°C and 5% CO₂.
Thaw lentiviral vector stock solution and spin down at 10,000 rpm for 5 seconds to remove debris.
Transfer supernatant into a new tube carefully.
Dilute the supernatant with kSOM to achieve a final concentration of 1 x 10³ ng-p24/mL.
Prepare 5-10 μL drops of diluted lentiviral vector on 60 mm dishes.
Cover all drops with mineral oil.
Pipette up and down blastocysts in the first drop.
Transfer each blastocyst into each drop.
Incubate them at 37°C and 5% CO₂ for 5 hours.
Wash them 3 times in kSOM drops.
Transfer 8-10 transduced blastocysts into each uterus of pseudopregnant females (2.5 dpc).
Analyze at appropriate time during pregnancy (Day 7-24).
Deliver pups and placentas by caesarian section on Day 24 morning (19.5 dpc).
Inject 2 mg of progesterone around noon on Day 22.
Inject 2 mg of progesterone around noon on Day 23.
